fact: The driver moved the car while the marshals were attempting recovery.
offence: Breach of Article 33.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz), team representative and reviewed video, and in-car video evidence. The driver crashed on his own. The marshals were quickly on the scene to recover the car. The driver removed the steering wheel indicating to the marshals that he was abandoning the car. The team then informed the driver that they thought the car was safe to continue. The driver replaced the steering wheel while the marshals had started to feed the recovery loop through the roll hoop of the car. The driver admitted that he was not aware that the marshals had commenced the recovery procedure. The marshals recognizing that the driver was going to attempt to restart aborted the recovery attempt just as the driver drove the car away. The driver admitted that he did not know that the marshals had started the recovery procedure and accepted that removing the steering wheel was a clear indication of his intention to abandon the car. A potentially dangerous situation was created that was avoidable by the driver solely.
rules_referenced: Article 33.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Alleged Dangerous Driving
